name: 29 Palms Chess Club
notes: About Twentynine Palms Chess Club Welcome to the Twentynine Palms Chess Club, a community for chess enthusiasts in and around Twentynine Palms! We proudly serve both local residents and military personnel stationed at the Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center. Whether you live in the area or have a deep appreciation for Twentynine Palms, we invite you to join our growing community of chess players. Our goal is to foster a friendly and competitive chess environment where members can improve their skills and enjoy the game. Weather permitting, we hope to host weekly or monthly in-person meetings at local parks like Knotts Sky Park or Luckie Park, depending on interest and participation. No matter your skill level, you’re welcome here. Come play, learn, and connect with fellow chess lovers as we build a vibrant chess scene in Twentynine Palms!

name: Columbus Mulligan Chess Club
notes: A place where anyone is welcome to come, sip on a drink, relax, and not feel intimidated. Like the old English Pub, except with hot chocolate/coffee instead of beer, and chess instead of darts. Players of all strengths participate. The more experienced players tend to take a mentoring/teaching role to the less experienced players. It is a place where taking a move back is not frowned upon, thus the name of the club being 'The Mulligan Chess Club' (mulligan being a golf term for hitting the ball again, without a penalty, if you did not like your shot). We meet every Saturday from 2 PM to 7 PM at: Avery Muirfield Panera 6665 Perimeter Loop Rd Dublin, OH 43017 Join this free chess club at https://www.meetup.com/mulligan-columbus-chess-club/

name: Kona Chess Club
notes: The Kona Chess Club represents the community of Kona. You may join if you are a resident of Kona or are visiting Kona to play in FIDE and USCF rated chess tournaments. NO CHEATING will be TOLERATED. No chess engines can be used during any rated chess games. NO NEGATIVE OR DEROGATORY COMMENTS are allowed to be posted anywhere. NO SPAM. If you play in team matches, NO RESIGNING when the going gets rough. Also NO DRAWS because you are tired of playing. In chess, you play to WIN. Kona Chess Club meets Tuesday's 6-8P at the Kona Library. First hour is chess lesson. Last hour is free play. Meet other chess players. Bring your chess set.

name: Seven Cities
notes: This is an online club for chess.com players in the Hampton Roads, Virginia metro area. Our purpose is to develop a network of local area players who enjoy competitive play and would be interested in gathering not only for online events, but for over-the-board (OTB) events in the Hampton Roads area. Membership is not restricted by rating or geographical location, but we do intend to extend our online play to OTB challenges at local area meeting places. name: Seguin Public Library Chess Club
notes: The Seguin Public Library holds 2 chess events per month, providing patrons with an opportunity to learn and play chess in an informal setting. Chess boards and chess clocks are provided during each event. Both events are listed below: Chess Junior: For ages 6-11 of all skill levels. Chess Junior is held in the story hour room at the Seguin Public Library every first Wednesday of the month. All Ages Chess Club: Patrons of any age and any skill level are welcome to attend this informal chess club! All Ages Chess is held in the community meeting room at the Seguin Public Library every 4th Thursday of the month. The Seguin Public Library hopes to spread the love of chess with these 2 clubs and aims to continue spreading the enjoyment of chess to all in the community!
